## GE Vernova Bull Case Revisited Following Industrial Production Data Surprise

GEV's bull case rests on sustained demand for power infrastructure; a macro industrial production surprise as a positive check on that thesis matters most to a PM if it signals durable grid-buildout demand rather than a one-month data anomaly.

- A macro industrial production jolt is prompting a reassessment of the bull case for GEV.
- Coverage frames it as a question — whether the macro uptick keeps the bull case intact — rather than a definitive confirmation.
- The power infrastructure and energy storage thesis is intersecting with broader industrial growth signals.
